text:
Olivia Chen: quick sync — product is proposing a 'compatibility window + fallback adapter' for catalog migrations. want to land a default flow that minimizes customer breakage and ops toil. :eyes:
Samir Patel: high level — what's the proposed window length and what metrics gate the switch?
Olivia Chen: thinking 30 days opt-in for heavy customers, 7 days for self-serve. gates: perf (p95), correctness on eval prompts, and telemetry error rate.
Kevin Liu: ops reality: dedicated customers often lock models in contracts. we'll need an exception path and a manual approval flow for those. also GPU availability can force earlier fallback.
Maria Gomez: comms ask — we need a templated customer notice + migration checklist (data export, compatibility shim instructions). legal will require 60 days for some enterprise contracts.
catalog-bot: note created: migration-flow-proposal-2210000420 (link: https://redwood.internal/notes/2210000420) :robot_face:
Samir Patel: for metrics, propose: p95 latency delta <= 15% and eval pass-rate drop <= 2% on the customer-owned prompt set. also monitor hallucination/regression signals.
Kevin Liu: ops nuance: recommend 'staged traffic split' with canary at 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback triggers. batching impact could change latency baseline; include batch-aware baselines.
Olivia Chen: launch gates draft: 1) bench infra: per-model runbook + quant/prof settings; 2) telemetry dashboards for customer evals; 3) migration playbook + opt-out endpoint; 4) legal/comms signoff.
Maria Gomez: add SLA clause for fallback and fallback costs. marketing wants a one-pager about rollback guarantees.
Samir Patel: depends on engineering effort — estimate 2 wks for runbook tooling + 3 wks for canary infra + 1 wk for dashboards = 6 wks. prioritize: runbook tooling & canaries first.
Olivia Chen: owners: Samir -> metric gating and dashboards, Kevin -> canary infra + ops automation, Maria -> comms + legal runbook, me -> product signoff and rollout plan.
Kevin Liu: ops follow-ups: need a compatibility shim artifact that maps tokenizer/model differences, and an adapter for KV cache reuse where possible. I'll sketch an RFC by EOW.
Maria Gomez: I'll draft the customer notice template and post to #product-comms for review tomorrow.
Olivia Chen: agreement: ship a pilot with 3 customers on a 30-day window, measure quality/regression + cost delta. if pilot passes, expand. Next sync Tues 10am. :thumbsup: :party_parrot:
